```{=html}
<style>
  body {

<div class="reports-page">
  <h1 class="page-title">Reports</h1>
  <p class="page-subtitle">Download your reports as PDFs, or use the HTML dashboards to interact with specific elements of your data.</p>
  <div id="reports-container">
    <p class="reports-status">Loading reports…</p>
  </div>
</div>


<script>
  const { createClient } = supabase;
  const client = createClient(
    'https://plsrkfhxfzwzvrtciios.supabase.co',
    'sb_publishable_2spGzG3-1-xfAGai7r_SSQ_h3TkSHXJ'
  );

  const BUCKET = 'Reports';

  function formatDisplayName(filename) {
    return filename
      .replace(/\.pdf$/i, '')
      .replace(/_/g, ' ')
      .replace(/\b\w/g, c => c.toUpperCase());
  }

  function formatYearHeading(folderName) {
    // "2024-2025" → "2024 - 2025"
    return folderName.replace(/^(\d{4})-(\d{4})$/, '$1 - $2');
  }

  async function downloadReport(path) {
    const { data, error } = await client.storage
      .from(BUCKET)
      .createSignedUrl(path, 60); // URL valid for 60 seconds
    if (error) {
      alert('Could not generate download link. Please try again.');
      console.error(error);
      return;
    }
    const a = document.createElement('a');
    a.href = data.signedUrl;
    a.download = path.split('/').pop();
    a.click();
  }

  function buildReportRow(displayName, filePath) {
    const row = document.createElement('div');
    row.className = 'report-row';
    row.innerHTML = `
      <span class="report-name">${displayName}</span>
      <div class="report-actions">
        <button class="report-btn download-btn">
          <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round">
            <path d="M12 3v13M7 11l5 5 5-5"/>
            <path d="M5 21h14"/>
          </svg>
          Download PDF
        </button>
        <a href="#" class="report-btn">
          <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round">
            <circle cx="11" cy="11" r="8"/>
            <line x1="21" y1="21" x2="16.65" y2="16.65"/>
          </svg>
          View Dashboard
        </a>
      </div>
    `;
    row.querySelector('.download-btn').addEventListener('click', () => downloadReport(filePath));
    return row;
  }

  async function loadReports() {
    const { data: { session } } = await client.auth.getSession();
    if (!session) {
      window.location.href = 'login.html?redirect=reports.html';
      return;
    }

    // Get user's institution
    const { data: profile, error: profileError } = await client
      .from('user_profiles')
      .select('institution')
      .eq('id', session.user.id)
      .single();

    const container = document.getElementById('reports-container');

    if (profileError || !profile?.institution) {
      container.innerHTML = '<p class="reports-status">Could not load your institution profile.</p>';
      return;
    }

    const institution = profile.institution;
    document.querySelector('.page-title').textContent = 'Reports for ' + institution;

    // List year folders at bucket root
    const { data: rootItems, error: listError } = await client.storage
      .from(BUCKET)
      .list('', { limit: 100, sortBy: { column: 'name', order: 'desc' } });

    if (listError || !rootItems) {
      container.innerHTML = '<p class="reports-status">Could not load reports.</p>';
      return;
    }

    // Folders have no file metadata (id is null)
    const yearFolders = rootItems.filter(item => item.id === null);

    let anyReports = false;
    container.innerHTML = '';

    for (const yearFolder of yearFolders) {
      const year = yearFolder.name;
      const folderPath = `${year}/${institution}`;

      const { data: files } = await client.storage
        .from(BUCKET)
        .list(folderPath, { limit: 100 });

      const pdfs = (files || []).filter(f => f.name.toLowerCase().endsWith('.pdf'));
      if (pdfs.length === 0) continue;

      anyReports = true;

      const section = document.createElement('div');
      section.className = 'reports-year-section';
      section.innerHTML = `<div class="reports-year-heading">${formatYearHeading(year)}</div>`;

      for (const file of pdfs) {
        const displayName = formatDisplayName(file.name);
        const filePath = `${folderPath}/${file.name}`;
        section.appendChild(buildReportRow(displayName, filePath));
      }

      container.appendChild(section);
    }

    if (!anyReports) {
      container.innerHTML = '<p class="reports-status">No reports available for your institution yet.</p>';
    }
  }


  loadReports();
</script>
```
